versions.content: enumeration SMState [SWS_CM_90422] Upstream: RS_E2E_08534 , RS_AP_00114 , RS_AP_00115 , RS_AP_00119 enum class SMState : std::uint8_t {...}; The state of the E2E supervision after the most recent check of a received sample of the event. If ara::com::e2e::SMState == kValid, and the ara::com::SamplePtr :: GetProfileCheckStatus did not result in an Error then, the last checked sample can be used. Header-Datei #include "ara/com/e2e/sm_state.h" class mono Forwarding-Header #include "ara/com/com_fwd.h" class mono Scope namespace ara::com::e2e class mono Symbol SMState class mono Basistyp std::uint8_t class mono Werte th Enumerator th Beschreibung td kValid td Communication of the samples of this event is functioning properly according to E2E checks; sample(s) can be used td kNoData td No data have been received from the publisher at all td kInit td Not enough data where the E2E check yielded OK from the publisher is available since the initialization; sample(s) cannot be used td kInvalid td Too little data (where the E2E check yielded OK), or too much data (where the e2e check yielded ERROR) were received within the E2 E time window - communication of the sample of this event not functioning properly; sample(s) cannot be used td kStateMDisabled td No E2E state machine available. Return value of function Get SMState if disableEndToEndStateMachine == TRUE td kIncompatibleQoS td Samples can’t be received because configured QoS policies at each end of communication don’t match. (Only applicable to certain network bindings.) Siehe auch: [PRS_E2E_00322] , [PRS_E2E_00678]
